Cleaning heritage woodwork should be done gently to avoid damage. Use soft brushes or cloths with mild soap and water, avoiding harsh chemicals that can strip finishes. Applying a protective wax or oil annually can help maintain moisture levels and enhance the wood's natural lustre. For intricate carvings, use a soft toothbrush to remove dust from crevices.
